title: Zelensky confirms Ukraine targeted Russian emergency alert systems in retaliatory hack
summary: Late on Nov. 1, Ukraine's Air Alert app, which provides vital updates to citizens about incoming Russian strikes, was hacked. Hours after the false warnings were sent to Ukrainian citizens' phones, Russia's own air raid alert system began to show signs of being compromised.

title: As Moldova speeds past Ukraine on reforms, Brussels set to reveal verdict on Kyiv's EU progress
summary: The EU’s Nov. 4 Enlargement Package will grade Ukraine’s accession progress and will likely show how far Moldova has outpaced Kyiv on reforms.

title: Poland deploys counterterrorism police near Russian border amid sabotage warnings
summary: According to RMF FM, Polish military intelligence and allied intelligence services warned last week that acts of sabotage could occur near the Russian border, potentially including incursions by armed groups.

title: Russian missile attack hits Kharkiv medical facility, injuring 73
summary: Terekhov said approximately 200 patients would be evacuated to other medical facilities as emergency services worked at the scene.

title: Russian oil refinery in Yaroslavl reportedly struck, multiple fires reported
summary: Ukraine has repeatedly targeted the facility, including most recently, a Sept. 17 strike that damaged its AVT-3 crude oil processing unit, according to Ukraine's General Staff.

title: Putin orders Russian data centers to reserve capacity to assist state IT infrastructure
summary: With the decree, a newly established government commission will have the authority to claim reserved capacity, which must be made accessible within 24 hours of the government's notification.

title: Witkoff reveals location, date for new trilateral peace deal negotiations
summary: U.S. Special Envoy Steve Witkoff announced on Nov. 3 that new rounds of trilateral peace negotiations between Russia, Ukraine, and the U.S. will be held on Nov. 10 in Abu Dhabi.

title: Kyiv faces emergency power cuts, widespread water outages after Russia's largest attack on energy infrastructure this year
summary: The widespread power and water outages in Kyiv follow Russia's largest mass attack on Ukraine's energy infrastructure this year, which targeted substations, transmission systems, and power plants across the country.

title: Norway, other European nations vow to boycott Ice Hockey World Championship if Russia returns
summary: "Norway will – based on the current situation and the information available to us today – not play against Russia at ​the World Championship in Germany in May 2027," said Norges Ishockeyforbund, Norway's ice hockey association, in a statement.

title: Ukraine's ombudsman, sanctioned Russian commissioner invited to Melania Trump's White House event, source says
summary: The White House announced on Nov. 3 that representatives from Ukraine and Russia would join the first lady for her remarks on the humanitarian operation in Oleshky.

title: Survival is 'just a bonus' — Inside one of the Ukrainian army's most dangerous jobs
summary: KHARKIV OBLAST — On a summer day in an abandoned village in eastern Ukraine, drones had just zeroed in on a house when a Russian soldier, claiming to surrender, walked out. title: Former deputy defense minister appointed to lead Ukraine's state-run defense giant
summary: Lieutenant General Ivan Havryliuk, a former first deputy defense minister, has been appointed to lead Ukroboronprom, Ukraine's largest state-owned defense company, according to a Nov. 3 statement.

title: Russian attacks across Ukraine kill 38, injure 167, as Russia hits Dnipro hospitals in morning missile strike
summary: The Air Force said Russia launched an unspecified number of ballistic missiles, including the Iskander-M, North Korean KN-23, and Zircon types, in addition to 59 cruise missiles and 289 attack drones against Ukraine overnight, mostly targeting Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Vinnytsia oblasts.

title: Zelensky arrives in Berlin for meeting with German Chancellor on air defense, energy sector
summary: "Important meetings lie ahead, as well as strengthening our air defense and supporting our energy sector. This will be the priority of today’s talks," said Zelensky on social media upon arriving in Germany.

title: Russia unleashes biggest mass attack on Ukraine's energy this year
summary: Energy officials recorded one of the largest waves of Russian ballistic missiles targeting critical infrastructure, with Russia also launching cruise missiles, jet-powered drones, and propeller-powered drones, Vitalii Zaichenko, CEO of Ukrenergo, the country's state grid operator, told the Kyiv Independent.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,594,830 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,060 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.
